title: NextNav advances commercial 5G-based 3D PNT solution in expanded partnership with Japan’s MetCom
summary: NextNav Inc. has announced an expanded strategic and technology partnership with Japan-based MetCom, Inc., focusing on NextNav's 5G-based 3D PNT solution. This collaboration marks NextNav's first international partnership for its 5G-based PNT technology, addressing the global need for resilient terrestrial positioning, navigation, and timing solutions that complement existing GNSS. MetCom will license NextNav's technology to build a terrestrial 5G network in Japan, initially providing timing services in major metropolitan areas, enhancing PNT capabilities in complex urban environments.

title: FatPipe Inc Highlights Proven Fail-Proof Autonomous Vehicle Connectivity Solutions to Avoid Waymo San Francisco Outage-like Situations
summary: FatPipe Inc addresses the critical need for robust, multi-network connectivity in autonomous vehicles, referencing recent Waymo outages in San Francisco. The company highlights its sub-second seamless switching technology, demonstrated in Project Darwin, which combines GEO satellite, LEO satellite, and 4G/5G cellular networks to achieve 99+% connectivity availability, even when individual networks experience significant outages. This solution aims to prevent service disruptions caused by network degradation or failures in autonomous mobility deployments.
